verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's docs include an 'Individual targeting' page and state that you can target individuals alongside segments and attribute rules. The pricing page confirms flags can be targeted 'by user, segment, or rule', and targeting can carry expiration dates for time-limited inclusion such as beta testers. Exclusion is only implied by serving a different variation to individuals, not explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of excluding individual users, in-depth detail on individual target lists (e.g., internal-account allowlists), independent hands-on corroboration of per-user targeting specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: In addition to targeting specific context attributes, you can target individuals, segments, or specific mobile apps and devices.
Create as many feature flags as you need and target them by user, segment, or rule.
You can even set expiration dates for flag targeting if you know you only want customers to receive a flag for a specific period of time.
